answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 18922 Country: India Title: Giving tawiz with Quranic verses to the non-Muslims Question: Respected Janab Mufti Saheb, Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Barakaatuhu ! Q No.1: "A man who is Sakhi is a friend of Allah although he may be a Faasiq." Is this statement a Hadith of Hazrat Mohammad (s.)? Q. No.2 I am an Alim and sometimes non-muslims come to me and ask for 'tabiz'. Is it allowed to give 'tabiz' with verse of Al-Quran to non-muslims? Jazakallah Kharian Answer ID: 18922 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 121/121/M=1431) (1) We are not aware of any such hadith. (2) It may be allowable if they are not feared to desecrate it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
